basic_details.job_title: APSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 137 Posts
basic_details.department: Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Department, Govt. of Assam
basic_details.short_information: Assam Public Service Commission (APSC) has invited online applications for 137 Veterinary Officer/Block Veterinary Officer (VO/BVO) posts under the Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Department, Government of Assam, through Advt. No. 11/2026 dated 3rd August 2026. Candidates who are permanent residents of Assam and hold a degree in Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Science can apply online at apscrecruitment.in from 7 August 2026 to 6 September 2026. The recruitment is for direct appointment on a pay scale of Rs. 30,000 – Rs. 1,10,000 with Grade Pay Rs. 12,700 under Pay Band 4. Full details on eligibil

Applications without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected, and fees once paid are non-refundable under any circumstances.

age_limit.details: Candidates should not be less than 21 years and not more than 38 years of age as on 01-01-2026. Age is calculated based on the Class-X/Class-XII Examination Admit Card/Pass Certificate/Marksheet issued by a recognized Central/State Board/Council where the Date of Birth is clearly reflected; no other document is accepted for age proof. | Candidates with less than 40% disability will not be considered for any relaxation applicable to Persons with Benchmark Disability.

qualification.details: Candidates must possess at least a Degree in Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Science from any recognized University/Institution. Applicants are required to upload relevant mark sheets/grade sheets of each semester/year reflecting the subjects, along with the final pass certificate.

how_to_apply: Applicants must apply online through the APSC Recruitment website; no other mode of application is accepted.
Visit the official APSC recruitment website: apscrecruitment.in
New applicants must click on 'Register Here' and complete the One-Time Registration (OTR) process with basic details, using a valid and active email address and mobile number
After registration, log in using the registered email/mobile number and password
Fill in all required registration details as asked in the form; mandatory fields are marked with an asterisk (*)
Read the eligibility criteria carefully before applying

Upload required documents/certificates (Date of Birth, Educational Qualifications, caste/category, etc.) in PDF format, not exceeding 4 MB, legible in print, scanned at 200 dpi in greyscale (recommended)
Upload a recent Photograph (50 KB – 200 KB) and Signature (50 KB – 200 KB)
Tick the declaration checkbox to enable the Preview option, and check all uploaded documents for clarity
Click 'Proceed to Pay' to continue, or 'Cancel' to make corrections
Complete the payment of the prescribed application fee
Note that no editing of the application is allowed after final submission
Take a printout of the submitted Online Application Form for future reference

Before filling the application form, candidates must note that certificates relating to age, caste, and minimum educational qualification will be fetched from the OTR profile. Candidates should update their OTR profile if any additional documents are to be uploaded in support of the advertised post. Applicants without debit card/internet banking facilities may also apply through Common Service Centers (CSCs).

content_sections.heading: APSC Veterinary Officer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To be eligible for APSC VO/BVO Recruitment 2026, candidates must meet the nationality, domicile, educational, and age criteria detailed below. The candidate must be an Indian Citizen as defined in Articles 5 to 8 of the Constitution of India and must be a permanent resident of Assam. As proof of domicile, candidates must upload either a valid Permanent Resident Certificate issued in Assam for educational purposes or a valid Employment Exchange Registration Certificate.

content_sections.heading: APSC Veterinary Officer Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess at least a Degree in Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Science from any recognized University/Institution. Applicants are required to upload relevant mark sheets/grade sheets of each semester/year reflecting the subjects, along with the final pass certificate.

content_sections.heading: APSC Veterinary Officer Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates should not be less than 21 years and not more than 38 years of age as on 01-01-2026. Age is calculated based on the Class-X/Class-XII Examination Admit Card/Pass Certificate/Marksheet issued by a recognized Central/State Board/Council where the Date of Birth is clearly reflected; no other document is accepted for age proof. Candidates with less than 40% disability will not be considered for any relaxation applicable to Persons with Benchmark Disability.

rows.upper_age_limit: Not specified in the official notification

rows.age_relaxation: 3 years for OBC/MOBC, 5 years for SC/ST over the unreserved limit

content_sections.heading: APSC Veterinary Officer Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive Pay Scale plus Grade Pay plus other allowances as admissible to Assam State Government employees from time to time.

content_sections.heading: APSC Veterinary Officer Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee for APSC VO/BVO Recruitment 2026 varies by category, with an additional processing fee charged by CSC-SPV for all applicants. Candidates seeking fee relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/MOBC/BPL categories must produce a certificate of the claimed category issued by a competent authority. Applications without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected, and fees once paid are non-refundable under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: APSC Veterinary Officer Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection procedure will be notified later by the Commission through a corrigendum/addendum. The Commission will decide the mode of selection considering the status, cadre, and grade of the post, and the number of applications received. The Commission may also conduct the examination/test zone-wise depending on the number of candidates from each district, based on the following six zones. Candidates must, if required, attend a personal interview/Viva-Voce at a place fixed by the Commission. The Commission does not defray travelling or other expenses of candidates summoned for interview.

content_sections.heading: APSC Veterinary Officer Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the following documents, and produce originals with self-attested copies at the time of interview: Permanent Resident Certificate (Assam) or Employment Exchange Registration Certificate as domicile proof Degree mark sheets/grade sheets of each semester/year and final pass certificate in Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Science Class-X/Class-XII Admit Card/Pass Certificate/Marksheet showing Date of Birth, for age proof Certificates and mark sheets of all examinations from HSLC onwards up to the qualifying examination Experience Certificate (wherever necessary) Caste certificate issued by the Government of Assam for SC/ST/OBC/MOBC candidates BPL certificate issued by the Government of Assam (wherever necessary) PwBD certificate (40% or more benchmark disability) issued by competent authority, if applicable Ex-Servicemen Identity Card and Discharge Book, if applicable Declaration Form-A regarding "The Small Family Norms" as per Notification No. ABP.69/2019/17 dated 6th November 2019 Government employment certificate or No Objection Certificate (NOC), if already in Government service Identity proof (PAN Card, Driving License, Passport, Voter ID, Aadhaar Card, etc.) at the time of Screening/Written Test and Interview Recent Photograph (50 KB – 200 KB, not older than 3 months) and Signature (50 KB – 200 KB)

faq.question: Q1. What is APSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Assam Public Service Commission (Advt. No. 11/2026) to fill 137 Veterinary Officer/Block Veterinary Officer (VO/BVO) posts under the Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Department, Government of Assam.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in APSC VO/BVO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 137 vacancies are available for the post of Veterinary Officer/Block Veterinary Officer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for APSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closing date is 6 September 2026, and the last date for payment of application fee is 8 September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for APSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold at least a Degree in Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Science from a recognized University/Institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for APSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 38 years of age as on 01-01-2026, with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST, OBC/MOBC, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen candidates as per Government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for APSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The total fee is Rs. 297.20 for General category, Rs. 197.20 for OBC/MOBC, and Rs. 47.20 for SC/ST/BPL/PwBD candidates (inclusive of CSC-SPV processing fee).

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for APSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through apscrecruitment.in by completing One-Time Registration (OTR), filling the application form, uploading required documents, and paying the prescribed fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for APSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection procedure will be notified later by the Commission through a corrigendum/addendum, and the examination/test may be conducted zone-wise.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for APSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a pay scale of Rs. 30,000 – Rs. 1,10,000 with Grade Pay of Rs. 12,700 under Pay Band 4, plus other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q10. Who is eligible to apply for APSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Indian citizens who are permanent residents of Assam, hold a Degree in Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Science, and meet the prescribed age limit are eligible to apply.
